title: Harden template and configuration execution boundaries
description:
Purpose: Investigate and improve generic security boundaries for repository-owned templates and configuration rendering.

Scope: Sanitized research, compatibility analysis, and future hardening work.

Exclusions: Client-specific configurations, data, incidents, and production deployment changes.

Definition of Done: Security boundary work is documented, tested with synthetic fixtures, and tracked through scoped child issues.
